responsibilities.interpretation: Existing code-only host observation fixture; successful installed human-instruction production is not established.

responsibilities.name: Persistence and interruption
responsibilities.interpretation: Existing authored Core attempt history plus new actual cold-client/lost-reply control. Recovery source has separate lead-owned evidence.

prior_evidence.policy: Preserve original source bindings and limits. Historical passes are not silently promoted to this package. The small reused selection above is rerun against the installed candidate; unrelated suites are not selected.

acceptance_limits: This is a verification baseline, not all six module acceptance conditions.
Integration, independent review and required connection results remain separate.
Actual provider, model, delivery and host/platform evidence is not supplied by contract fixtures.
Writing approval is exercised through WritingService with a labelled authored review, not fresh semantic review.
